status: Fixed before any CGE, variance component, R2 or in-season forecast of E012 was computed. Only data-semantics facts (game_id order, polars dummy coding, column names, class counts) had been inspected. Anything decided after this point is labeled post hoc in E012.json.

choices.choice: Position = Combine position (linkage.player_table().position). WR traits use Combine WRs only (no TE), DB traits Combine DBs. Draft class = draft_year.
choices.reason: Same population definition as every earlier experiment; the prereg names positions, not NFL roles.

choices.choice: Regular-season (REG) games only. Chronological order of a player's games = game_id order (game_id encodes YYYYMMDD; verified monotone in season and week).
choices.reason: AGENTS.md: outcomes are regular season. game_id is the only date field.

choices.choice: A game qualifies for trait T if the player has at least the prereg minimum number of plays/events in it with a finite play-level value of T (after the trait's own play filters). The per-game value is the mean of those play values (T1/T12: their 0.9 quantile, polars default 'nearest' interpolation, as features.game_top_speed uses).
choices.reason: The prereg gives minimum counts per game; counting only plays that carry a value makes the count and the value refer to the same plays.

choices.choice: A player enters trait T (variance components, reliability, R2, CGE) with >= 3 qualifying games; the same player set is used for every information set.
choices.reason: Prereg: players with >= 3 qualifying games. A common sample keeps C0-C3 comparable.

choices.choice: Play max = max raw `s` over all tracked frames of a REG player-play (probes.f_drill_intensity.play_max_speeds, as E001/E010); plays > 12 yd/s dropped; recomputed for all Combine WRs and DBs (e010_play_max covers only E010's population).
choices.reason: Prereg definition; e010_play_max.parquet lacks players without drill-intensity features.

choices.choice: Rebuild E002 game events with probes.a_route_breaks (game_route_plays -> game_frames -> game_events). Play value = retention of found OUT/IN events minus the route-type mean over all found WR+TE events of that route (E002 game_trait centering). WR rows only.
choices.reason: Prereg: route-centered E002 definitions. Verified against probe_a_game_traits raw means before use.

choices.choice: Found HITCH events, peak_decel minus the HITCH mean over all found WR+TE HITCH events. WR rows only.
choices.reason: E002 game_trait definition (route-centered).

choices.choice: Play value = soe from probes.a_route_breaks.separation_over_expected (E002: HGB, GroupKFold(5) by player over all WR+TE route plays with a separation value, SCREEN excluded), on HITCH/OUT/IN routes, WR rows only. Fit inside threadpool_limits(3).
choices.reason: Prereg: E002 soe definition.

choices.choice: Play value = yprr_oe from data/processed/e007_routes.parquet (E007 cross-fit), WR rows only.
choices.reason: Prereg: E007 yprr_oe residuals.

choices.topic: DL first-second rush distance and get-off
choices.choice: From probe_b_game_plays.parquet: pass-rush snaps (rush == True) lined up EDGE or INTERIOR_LINE. Play value = d10 (T6) or player_get_off (T7) minus its alignment mean plus the overall mean (b_dl_burst.center_by_alignment formula), means taken over all such snaps of study DL with a finite value. No >= 30-snap player filter (E012 has its own per-game rule).
choices.reason: E003 alignment adjustment; E003's player filter (>= 30 snaps) belonged to its player-level traits, not to play values. T7 follows E003's g_getoff_rush, which is alignment-adjusted.

choices.choice: Play value = pressure (time_to_pressure non-null) minus the alignment (EDGE / INTERIOR_LINE) base rate over all pass-rush snaps of study DL; per-game mean over pass-rush snaps (>= 10).
choices.reason: E003 definition of pressure over expected (alignment base rate as the expectation).

choices.choice: Rebuild with probes.c_ol_lateral (pass_block_plays -> add_expectations -> pass_set_frames -> pass_set_metrics). Play value = set_accel_c (peak a_tan 0-0.6 s on non-play-action dropbacks >= 2 s with a full 0-2 s window, minus its T/G/C mean). Verified against probe_c_game before use.
choices.reason: Prereg: E004 set_accel play values.

choices.choice: Play value = pr_oe = pressure_allowed - p_hat from c_ol_lateral.add_expectations (logistic on dropback spline, T/G/C, 2+ rushers, play action, season; in-sample over all pass-block snaps, as E004). Per-game mean over pass-block snaps (>= 15).
choices.reason: Prereg: E004 pr_oe definitions.

choices.choice: From probe_d_game_backpedal_plays.parquet: d_db_transition.game_backpedal_events (bp_peak winsorized at the 1%/99% quantiles of all plays, minus its alignment x coverage-assignment cell mean). Per-game mean over plays (>= 3).
choices.reason: Prereg: E005 gm_backpedal play values.

choices.choice: Stratified one-way random-effects ANOVA with draft-year strata: MSW = within-player mean square (df N - k); MSB = sum n_i (m_i - stratum game-weighted mean)^2 / (k - Y); n0 = (N - sum_y sum_{i in y} n_i^2 / N_y) / (k - Y); tau2 = (MSB - MSW) / n0, sigma2 = MSW, lambda = sigma2 / tau2. With one stratum this is exactly reliability.icc1's ANOVA estimator (unit-tested). tau2 <= 0 -> lambda = inf and CGE undefined (counted, reported).
choices.reason: Prereg: icc1 machinery after draft-year centering; the stratified form gives the centering its correct degrees of freedom.

choices.choice: rel = tau2 / (tau2 + mean_i sigma2 / n_i) over the trait's players (n_i = qualifying games). icc1-style mean Spearman-Brown reliability and odd/even-game split-half are reported alongside, descriptive.
choices.reason: This is the ratio of true-score to observed variance of the player means that the CV MSE averages over, so R2_CV / rel is unbiased for the true-score R2 under the model.

choices.choice: y_i = mean of the player's qualifying game values. Var_w = sum_i (y_i - player-weighted draft-year mean)^2 / (n - Y). CV = RepeatedKFold(5 folds, 20 repeats, random_state 0) over players sorted by nfl_id; per repeat R2 = 1 - mean_i (y_i - oof_i)^2 / Var_w; R2_CV = mean over repeats. R2_true = clip(R2_CV / rel, 0, 0.99).
choices.reason: Prereg (20 repeats, 5-fold, player-level, true-score correction, clip). Full-sample within-year variance as denominator (LESSONS 2026-10-14: normalize by the full-sample variance).

choices.choice: C0 = the training-fold mean of y within the player's draft year (training-fold overall mean if the class is absent from the fold). C1-C3 = linkage._model() (median impute + indicators -> StandardScaler -> RidgeCV) on [draft-year dummies (all classes except the earliest, deterministic) + the set's columns]. C1 = + linkage.COMBINE_CONTROLS; C2 = C1 + linkage.DRAFT_CONTROLS; C3 = C2 + c40_smax, c40_v_20_40, c40_vmax, c40_tau, c40_a0 (speed.combine_speed_table, QC-passing attempts) + the matched signature (T2/T4 c_turn_retention, T3 c_stop_peak_decel, T6-T8 c40_d10, T9/T10 cmb_rev_accel_mirror, T11 cmb_backpedal_speed; none for T1, T5, T12). Fits run under threadpool_limits.
choices.reason: Prereg information sets and model. linkage._design drops the first-APPEARING draft year (row-order dependent), so the dummy coding is written out explicitly.

choices.choice: CGE_C = lambda R2_C / (1 - R2_C) with R2_C = R2_true. Reported for C0-C3, Delta CGE = CGE(C3) - CGE(C2) (tracking), and descriptive CGE(C2) - CGE(C1) (draft slot) and CGE(C1) - CGE(C0) (stopwatch).
choices.reason: Prereg estimand.

choices.choice: 1,000 player resamples per trait (numpy default_rng seed 20261015 + trait index). Whole pipeline per resample: draft-year centering, variance components, rel, CV R2 (RepeatedKFold(5, 20, random_state = resample index) over the UNIQUE resampled players, so copies of a player never sit in train and test at once), CGE and Delta CGE. 95% percentile intervals; non-finite draws (tau2 <= 0 or rel <= 0) are counted, and an interval is reported as unbounded above when they exceed 2.5%.
choices.reason: Prereg (player bootstrap of the whole pipeline). Grouped folds prevent duplicated players from leaking across CV folds.

choices.choice: Players with >= 8 qualifying games. Game values centered by the full-sample game-weighted draft-year mean. X_k = mean of the chronologically first k games (k = 1..6). Target = mean of games 7..end (the games remaining after the longest window, so every comparison uses the same disjoint target). Combine forecast = the main CV's out-of-fold prediction averaged over its 20 repeats, minus the player-weighted draft-year mean of y. r = Pearson. Integer crossover = smallest k in 1..6 with r(X_k, target) >= r(C, target); 7 means '> 6' (censored). Agreement: ceil(formula CGE), clipped to [1, 7], lies inside the 95% percentile interval of the integer crossover over 1,000 player resamples. A continuous crossover (linear interpolation of r over k with r(0) = 0) is reported as descriptive.
choices.reason: The prereg says 'remaining games'; a common target removes target-length differences between k. Integers avoid an arbitrary interpolation rule in the agreement test.

choices.choice: Training = REG games of the 2023 and 2024 SEASONS (which contain only 2023 and 2024 class players). The 2023/2024 classes' 2025-season games are not used anywhere in validation 2. Test = 2025 class, 2025 season.
choices.reason: Strict reading of 'no 2025 data': the fit is what a club could have frozen before the 2025 season.

choices.choice: Every data-derived per-play constant is refit on training plays and applied unchanged to 2025 plays: T2/T3 route means (WR+TE events of 2023-24); T4 SOE model: training values cross-fitted by player (GroupKFold 5) within 2023-24 plays, 2025 values predicted by the same HGB specification fitted on all 2023-24 plays (categories coded from training labels; unseen labels missing); T5 yprr: training values cross-fitted by game (GroupKFold 5, HGB default, seed 0) within 2023-24 routes, 2025 values from the model fitted on all 2023-24 routes with season -> 2024 and defense_team_season -> <team>_2024 (the latest known team-season); T6/T7 alignment means and T8 alignment base rates from 2023-24 snaps; T9 T/G/C means from 2023-24 sets; T10 logistic expectation (spline knots, encoders, coefficients) fitted on 2023-24 snaps, 2025 snaps scored with season -> 2024; T11 winsorization quantiles and alignment x coverage cell means from 2023-24 plays. 2025 plays in a cell or category unseen in training get no value. The minimum-play thresholds and the 12 yd/s cap are fixed constants of the prereg, not data-derived.
choices.reason: Prereg leakage rule: no 2025 data may touch any expectation model, centering constant or threshold.

choices.choice: 2025 Combine measurements are forecast inputs (a club has them before the season). Drill z-score composites (c_turn_retention, c_stop_peak_decel, cmb_backpedal_speed) are recomputed with within-drill means/SDs estimated on the 2023-24 Combine classes only and applied to everyone, so no 2025 value enters a constant of the training fit. cmb_rev_accel_mirror keeps its definitional per-session centering (each session centers on its own Combine reps; no game data). Raw measures (40 time etc., c40 set, c40_d10) are unchanged.
choices.reason: Leakage rule applied to Combine-side constants as well; session centering is part of that feature's definition and uses only pre-season Combine data.

choices.choice: On training players (>= 3 qualifying 2023-24 games): draft-year strata 2023/2024 for variance components; rel and R2_C via the same 20x5 CV; ridge refit on all training players. 2025 prior mu_C = ridge prediction with the draft-year dummy set to its training mean (a new class gets the training-average class level); C0 prior = training mean of y. Traits with training tau2 <= 0 are excluded from validation 2.
choices.reason: A new class has no draft-year mean; the training average is the only leakage-free level.

choices.choice: For each 2025 player and k in 1..4 with >= k + 3 qualifying 2025 games: target = mean of games k+1..end; games-only = mean of games 1..k; Combine-only = mu_C; blend = mu_C + w_k (ybar_k - mu_C), w_k = k / (k + lambda (1 - R2_C)). Standardized SE = (forecast - target)^2 / tau2_train. Pooled = equal-weight mean over traits (traits with >= 1 eligible player at that k) of the trait's mean standardized SE.
choices.reason: Prereg.

choices.choice: Player-level paired difference d_i = sum over his traits t of (SE_A,it - SE_B,it) / (T n_t), so sum_i d_i equals the pooled trait-weighted mean difference. One-sided sign-flip permutation test (100,000 random sign vectors, seed 20261015; p = (1 + #{S* <= S}) / (1 + B), expected sign negative). 95% CI: 10,000 player-bootstrap resamples (per-trait means recomputed on each resample). BH across H1-H3 at alpha 0.05. Effect sizes: pooled standardized MSE of each method, their difference, and the ratio.
choices.reason: Prereg (100,000 flips, player bootstrap, BH); the prereg leaves the bootstrap count open.

choices.choice: Per-trait and k = 3, 4 comparisons are descriptive (bootstrap CIs; sign-flip p reported but in no BH family). Calibration: 80% predictive interval for the rest-of-season mean = blend +- 1.2816 sqrt(V_k + sigma2 / m), V_k = 1 / (1 / ((1 - R2_C) tau2) + k / sigma2), m = target games; all from training; coverage for C2 and C3 priors at k = 0..4, pooled (trait-weighted) and per trait.
choices.reason: Prereg secondary analyses.

choices.choice: Trait per position = the first-listed trait of that position in the prereg (WR T1, DL T6, OL T9, DB T11). 2025 rookies with >= 10 qualifying 2025 games; rank by |C2 prior - full rookie-season mean|; the 2 largest and 2 smallest per position (16 players). Panels show the prior, games-only running mean and blend (C2) after each game, and the season mean.
choices.reason: The prereg fixes the rule but not the trait; first-listed is a rule chosen without looking at results.

choices.choice: 2025 rookies with >= 10 qualifying 2025 games; z = (rookie-season mean - C2 prior) / sqrt((1 - R2_C2) tau2) with training quantities; top 3 by |z| per trait; the predictive z with sampling noise sqrt((1 - R2_C2) tau2 + sigma2 / n) is shown alongside. Descriptive.
choices.reason: Prereg: prior-SD units; the predictive z shows how much of the surprise is sampling noise.

choices.choice: corr(draft-year-centered y_i, log n_i games) per trait; corr(per-game value, qualifying plays in that game) pooled and within player (both centered by player).
choices.reason: Prereg exposure checks; the within-player version removes between-player role differences.

choices.choice: joblib n_jobs <= 3 with one BLAS/OpenMP thread per worker (threadpool_limits(1)); HGB fits inside threadpool_limits(3); lazy scans filtered before collect.
choices.reason: Project memory/CPU rules.
